name: Launch Trailer
designSoul: Earn one unforgettable reveal through disciplined restraint everywhere else.

typography: compact labels only when they add credibility
decorationDNA: soft fields, sparse glints, one recurring launch signal
assetTreatment: hero assets need explicit focal points and truthful orientation-specific crops
codeTreatment: show only the decisive fragment; keep it real and selectable

motion.signatureMove: A quiet field gathers into one crisp reveal, then immediately settles.
motion.interruption: Any reveal can be skipped without losing the final product state.
motion.cleanup: Exceptional canvases and workers are bounded, removed, and followed by zero owned work.
motion.reducedEndpoint: The reveal resolves instantly to the same focal hierarchy with a short opacity change at most.

landscape: use width as dramatic negative space
place the focal reveal off-center when it strengthens tension
portrait: reserve a strong upper claim region
move the reveal to the center-lower stage
keep social UI safe areas clear
stacking: never bury the final action below decorative content
focalPoint: declare one focal point per hero asset
use an alternate crop or asset when aspect changes
prohibitedBehavior: turning a wide hero into a tiny portrait thumbnail

qa: compare focal hierarchy in both aspects
